title: The autopilot's first unattended night
goal: A manager tick never leaves a dirty tree that stops the next sync, a runner restart is never refused for untracked hook drafts, a headless session cannot sync to another branch or remote or write guard files, an unattended sprint cannot approve changes to its own guards, closed sprints' status files do not crowd out live ones, a runner that lands nothing does not restart forever, and a signal before the child writes status leaves a record

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
